main.remarks: Generates zero or more access-key assertions asynchronously for an approved issuance flow using the assertion-generator context supplied by an access manager.

method.name: GenerateAsync
method.summary: Generate access-key assertions asynchronously for an approved issuance flow.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous generation flow.
method.returns: Generated access-key assertions, or an empty array when no assertions are produced.
